COVID-19 healthcare system challenge

The COVID-19 pandemic has challenged the healthcare system, and Singapore will keep fighting the disease while transforming health systems sustainably.

  2. s00003 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yongcontext

    The COVID-19 pandemic has presented an unprecedented challenge for our healthcare system.

  3. s00004 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong

Mr Gan Kim Yong
National Centre for Infectious Disease strategy

The National Centre for Infectious Disease opened in September 2019, and the strategy is to prevent spread, detect cases, contain contacts and provide care.

  1. s00007 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yongcontext

    We established the National Centre for Infectious Disease, which had its official opening in September 2019.

  2. s00008 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong

    We will press on with our strategy to fight the disease: First, to collectively prevent spread of COVID-19 through practicing safe management in how we conduct our daily activities; Second, detect new cases as early as possible; Third, contain close contacts of new cases to prevent further transmission; and finally, provide quick and effective care for patients to allow them to recover and return to their normal lives.

Mr Gan Kim Yong
Three shifts in healthcare

Three major shifts will move healthcare beyond healthcare to health, hospital to community, and quality to value, including preventive healthcare subsidies.

  1. s00023 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong

    To achieve this, we will press on with three major shifts in our healthcare system, to move Beyond Healthcare to Health, Beyond Hospital to Community, and Beyond Quality to Value.

  3. s00025 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yongcontext

    We will continue our efforts to improve the diets and lifestyle of Singaporeans, and we will find new ways to do this safely in light of COVID-19.

  4. s00026 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong

    We will also push on with our initiatives to make preventive healthcare more affordable and accessible, such as by enhancing subsidies for vaccinations in various settings.

Mr Gan Kim Yong

  1. s00031 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong

    While COVID-19 has pushed back the completion timelines for some of the upcoming new facilities, we will continue to expand our healthcare capacity, such as by building a new hospital in the east and new polyclinics across Singapore by 2030.

Mr Gan Kim Yong

Healthcare will stay affordable and sustainable, with ElderFund, CareShield Life, MediSave Care and a MediShield Life benefits and premiums review.

  1. s00034 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yongcontext

  2. s00035 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong

    These include three new initiatives from 2020: ElderFund, launched in January 2020, as well as CareShield Life and MediSave Care, to be launched by the end of this year.

  3. s00036 · 1422Mr Gan Kim Yong
